{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Over the past decade, heavily armed and mostly white men have killed or injured close to 1,000 individuals in politically-motivated shootings and other mass killings.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These shootings and mass killings are not isolated incidents.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A rhetorical climate produced by right-wing politicians and media personalities encourages these shootings and mass killings.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Right-wing politicians and media personalities blame immigrants, poor African Americans and foreign countries for the decline in white working-class standards of living.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump blames Mexican immigrants, Muslim terrorists, Black protesters, China’s economic and military power and American leaders for barriers to America’s “greatness”.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nativist politics diverts attention from the capitalist class, which has declared war on working-class and poor people of all races.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republican leaders espouse nativist politics.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats like Barack Obama and both Bill and Hillary Clinton’s “free trade” and austerity policies contribute to the declining standards of working-class communities.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The failure to put forward convincing ways to explain and solve the crisis leaves a vacuum that racists easily fill.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
